title: After the Arima Kinen: Handing Off the Friendship Baton ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "You take it from here!" Daitaku Helios starts to lose steam after their breakaway, and Mejiro Palmer takes the lead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wins the Arima Kinen and the crowd starts chanting her name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer, the black sheep of the Mejiro family, has left her mark in history as the magnificent runaway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the winner's interview, she goes full party mode and then shows everyone her most impressive runaway yet.
